mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 62 degree weather with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, all under a Waxing Crescent moon.
The Verona Police Department has published its latest recap of calls for service from late August through mid-September, highlighting various traffic and safety incidents across the city.
There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Pizza and a Pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Trivia at The Bogey Factory.
On September 5, officers investigated a series of reports involving vehicles with slices of cheese placed on their windshields, a prank known as the Dairy Dare.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
